name: Silph Co. Upper Floors & Rival Battle (6F–9F)
summary: With Card Key access, ascend through the upper executive floors. On 7F, challenge Rival Blue in a pivotal battle, then speak to the grateful Silph employee in the adjacent office to receive a free Level 25 Lapras. Rest in the 9F medical infirmary bed to fully restore your squad before storming the boardroom.

items.name: Gift: Lapras
items.method: Given by the grateful Silph researcher in the 7F central office suite

items.name: Rare Candy

items.name: Full Restore
